corridors.name: Costa Verde ↔ Callao / La Punta
corridors.waypoint_guidance: Coastal run north-west along the Costa Verde cliffs from Chorrillos to Callao/La Punta, kept offshore of the Lima surf break; no land crossing.

corridors.name: La Punta ↔ Isla San Lorenzo
corridors.waypoint_guidance: Short crossing of Callao bay from the La Punta harbour to the north-east shore of San Lorenzo; keep clear of the port channel; no land crossing.

corridors.name: Callao ↔ Palomino Islands
corridors.waypoint_guidance: Run north-west from Callao past San Lorenzo's northern tip to the Palomino sea-lion colony; open bay water, no land crossing.

corridors.name: Paracas (El Chaco) ↔ Ballestas Islands
corridors.waypoint_guidance: North-west from El Chaco pier across the open Paracas bay to the Ballestas Islands; coordinate with reserve rules; no land crossing.

corridors.name: Lima (Costa Verde) ↔ Paracas (candidate)
corridors.waypoint_guidance: Open-Pacific coastal run ~112nm south from Lima to Paracas, held offshore of the coast the whole way; beyond Pioneer range — roadmap Quanta-LR; no land crossing.

vessel_gate_rule: <=70nm Pioneer II solid; 75-150nm Quanta-LR amber-dashed; >150nm review
_vessel_gate_note: Range-gated by hull. Long legs never faked on a 70nm boat.
